blocks.text: Working out ferry departures every 35 minutes from 07:40, I find the earliest one reaching the north pier at or after 08:55 is the 09:25 ferry, arriving 09:47. Checking the bus schedule, buses leave at 10 and 40 past each hour, so the next one after arrival would be 10:10.

Take the 09:25 ferry, the first one you can catch after reaching the north pier at 08:55 (the 08:50 leaves too early). It arrives at the south pier at 09:47, so you'll wait 23 minutes for the 10:10 bus, well ahead of your 11:00 deadline.
